## API Reference

This reference helps you implement the RESTful Pipedrive API. This API uses a JSON format for output and is capable of handling CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) requests. The API is stateless – all requests are validated against an API token. The API token can be [obtained](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/how-to-find-the-api-token) manually from the Pipedrive app.

#### OpenAPI 3

You can click on the "Run in Postman" button below to interact with our API. We have a [tutorial](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/run-pipedrive-api-in-postman-or-insomnia) for using Pipedrive API in Postman or Insomnia, but if you prefer to use a different tool, you can always import our OpenAPI 3 specification files (available for both [v1](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/openapi.yaml) and [v2](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/openapi-v2.yaml) APIs) into your tool of choice. See [this](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/pipedrive-api-v2) article to learn more about Pipedrive API v2. Keep in mind that we'll occasionally update our OpenAPI 3 specification files, so you might need to re-import them from time to time. For ready-to-use SDKs, read below under "Client libraries".

Notice!

Pipedrive's API and [extension points](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/app-extensions) cover the majority of our core product's functionality. As our product is constantly growing, so is our API. To be up to date with new additions and updates, please check out and subscribe to our [Changelog](https://developers.pipedrive.com/changelog) .

To test your applications, we recommend creating a new, separate Pipedrive account for sandboxing purposes. Go to [the Developer Sandbox Account](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/developer-sandbox-account) page to learn more and request your own sandbox account.

#### Developer Documentation

#### Want to create an app using Pipedrive API?

Learn about what [types of apps](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/marketplace-creating-a-proper-app#section-types-of-apps) you can create, check out our [coding tutorials](https://developers.pipedrive.com/tutorials/) and [start creating](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/marketplace-creating-a-proper-app) your own app.

#### Client libraries

We offer two official Pipedrive API client libraries: [Node.js](https://github.com/pipedrive/client-nodejs) and [PHP](https://github.com/pipedrive/client-php).

## Integrate and optimize with Pipedrive’s CRM API

Connect any software, system, or app in your technology stack with Pipedrive. Our open API (or Application Programming Interface) and Developer Platform give you the opportunity to integrate and optimize the tools you need, share data and automate your sales processes.

[Find out more Opens in new window](https://developers.pipedrive.com/)

4.5 of 5

4.7 of 5

##### Free API access with every plan

Grab your API token and unlock a world of possibilities with our RESTful Pipedrive API v1. Access what you need via webhooks, API endpoints, Postman, Insomnia, client libraries, SDKs and more.

##### Build and integrate what you need

Seamlessly integrate your existing technology stack and optimize your revenue cycle with apps from Pipedrive’s Marketplace, or build your own app using interactive app extensions like app panels and app actions.

##### Get started with developer resources and tools

Kick-start your development with our developer resources. Browse our API Reference and Developer Documentation to learn more and use our Developer Community and API clients on Github for help along the way.

## Easily connect Pipedrive with other software

Not a developer? No problem! With our flexible open platform, you can connect what you need with Pipedrive using the Zapier app or any of the hundreds of available apps in our Marketplace.

Syncing and sharing your CRM data between Pipedrive and any software, system, or app, like Slack, Zoom, Microsoft Teams and Leadfeeder, is both easy and secure.

With our powerful and flexible CRM API, the way you use Pipedrive is only limited by your imagination.

## Access the Pipedrive CRM API for free

Every Pipedrive plan comes with an API token that gives you access to our RESTful API for free. This means you can extend and customize your Pipedrive experience to streamline your business processes and improve your CRM software’s functionality and efficiency.

- Pull call lists and customer information and make them appear in your call center software
- Create new leads based on shared custom data in your data warehouse or any other tool in your tech stack
- Assign new tasks to your after-sales team via project management software once a deal is closed
- Integrate marketing automation and communication tools so you can streamline workflows and never miss notifications

These are just a few of many possibilities. The opportunities are endless with our CRM API.

## Integrate with your existing tech stack

**SOFTWARE FEATURE**

### All your tools in one platform

A good CRM tool has an open API that enables you to connect all the tools you use in one platform.

With Pipedrive’s RESTful API and developer resources, you can connect and integrate any app, software, or system in your tech stack with Pipedrive.

You, or your IT team, can also build custom CRM integrations to share and import data to empower your business processes.

**SOFTWARE FEATURE**

### Extend and customize using the API

No more manual data entry or imports and exports between systems! Automate all your everyday tasks.

Connect systems using the Zapier app, create webhooks to push information, or build your own integration using our developer resources.

Within our powerful and flexible API is our extensive API Reference with hundreds of endpoints. Along with our Developer Documentation, there are endless ways in which you can extend and customize Pipedrive to your business needs.

## How Pipedrive’s CRM API helps companies to empower their sales processes

##### SobTIC streamlined their business management with Pipedrive’s CRM API

Thanks to Pipedrive’s open API, SobTIC’s business management is more efficient and effective. By connecting Slack, Pipefy, Mailchimp and other everyday tools with Pipedrive, their team now has a singular hub to house all sales and administrative data.

[**Read the case study**](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog)

Opens in new window

##### Vindi leverages Pipedrive’s CRM API to manage their data lake by integrating sales data

For Vindi, the most important thing was deciding the API integration of pre- and post-sales data. By using Pipedrive’s API, they’ve built a unified system that incorporates their platform, Zendesk, RD Station and SenseData.

**[Read the case study](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/case-studies/vindi-case-study)**

##### Leni, Leon & die Luchse connected their tech stack using Pipedrive’s CRM API

Once Leni, Leon & die Luchse started using integrations and the Pipedrive API, they discovered how powerful Pipedrive and Zapier could be when connected with tools they already use; further empowering their sales process.

[**Read the case study**](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/case-studies/leni-leon-die-luchse-case-study)

## Build and test in a safe, secure environment

Our stable API lets you make API calls in a safe and secure environment, while receiving outputs in a JSON format, enabling you to fully customize your CRM system and create integrations that work for you! There are three types of apps you can create depending on your purpose and intended users. Secure authentication is managed using OAuth 2.0 authentication.

##### Create a public app

Public apps are available for all users in the Pipedrive Marketplace. The app has its own unique, public landing page, which can be promoted through the Pipedrive Marketplace.

##### Create an unlisted app

Unlisted apps cater to specific users in the Pipedrive Marketplace. The app has its own non-public app landing page and is only visible to users with its specific Marketplace URL.

##### Create a private app

Private apps are for users in the same company. As private apps aren’t published in our Marketplace, this allows you or your developers to develop exclusive integrations for your business only.

## Let our API documentation, developer resources and tools help you along the way

In addition to our [API Reference](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1) and [Developer Documentation](https://pipedrive.readme.io/), we have a host of connector tools to help you with accessing and using our API:

- Pipedrive API client libraries and SDKs on Github for PHP, JavaScript (Node JS), Python,.NET and Ruby
- Ready-to-import Open API 3 specification file for Postman, Insomnia, or any API tool of your choice
- An up-to-date changelog for all changes, especially breaking changes

## Built with security in mind

We know that every developer is concerned about the security of REST APIs and CRM account, which is why we keep our API under lock and key.

Access to the Pipedrive API is only possible using the API key or an access token when using OAuth 2.0. Not only does Pipedrive encrypt disks and enforce HTTPS from outside the network, but certain data inside the database is also encrypted when necessary.

We’ve mirrored the rigorous security approach outlined in the [OWASP Framework](https://owasp.org/www-project-api-security/) to ensure everything is safe. Plus, we take extra steps to keep our API secure by tracking issues like broken object level authorization and broken user authentications.

[**Read more about our security**](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/features/privacy-security)

## CRM API FAQs

- ### What is CRM API?
	A CRM’s API (Application Programming Interface) allows users to connect any software, system or app to it.
	Businesses that require bespoke integrations between their technology stack and CRM can use the API to create custom integrations to share data and automate their [sales processes](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/blog/sales-process).
	Interested in APIs beyond CRM? Learn more about application programming interfaces on our “ [What is API?](https://support.pipedrive.com/article/what-is-api)” page.
- ### How do I use web API in CRM?
	With the right CRM, web API should be simple. Pipedrive, for example, makes it easy to access and use your CRM API. With its RESTful Pipedrive API v1, you can access anything you need via webhooks, API endpoints, Postman, Insomnia, client libraries, SDKs and more.
	Plus, with API reference and developer documentation, as well as a Developer Community and API clients on Github, you can find resources to help you get your integration off the ground.
- ### Does CRM API benefit users?
	Yes. A CRM API is a powerful tool that allows users to integrate their favorite third-party software tools and systems with their CRM.
	On top of that, a CRM API lets users create various custom workflows between apps. Want to import call lists and customer information into your [call center software](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/crm/solutions/call-center-crm)? Looking to integrate your marketing and communication tools into your CRM? The possibilities are endless.

## Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive with MCP

Empower AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude to securely and reliably work with your Pipedrive data. Find deals, update records, get insights, move opportunities through your pipeline and automate workflows, all from your AI assistant.

Pipedrive is an official connector in Claude and ChatGPT. Find it in the connector directory and connect your account. No manual server setup required.

Pipedrive MCP

## How the Pipedrive MCP server works

The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open standard that lets AI assistants securely connect to external tools and data sources. With Pipedrive MCP, your AI assistant can securely access and act on your CRM data using natural language.

**Step 1: Connect securely**

Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes via a secure OAuth login. No coding, APIs, middleware or developer support required.

**Step 2: Ask your AI to act**

Simply tell ChatGPT or Claude what you want to do, using plain language directly from its input box.

**Step 3: Get instant results**

Your AI assistant can find information, update records, create activities and automate workflows using live Pipedrive data.

## Bring Pipedrive into your AI assistant

Sales work is increasingly happening inside AI assistants. Pipedrive MCP brings your CRM into that workflow, giving your AI assistant secure access to your live CRM data so it can help you move deals forward, automate busywork and surface insights instantly.

##### Query your CRM

Search deals, contacts, organizations and leads. Retrieve pipeline details, analyze sales activity and access customer information in seconds.

##### Take action

Create and update deals, contacts and activities. Convert leads, schedule follow-ups and keep your CRM up to date without manual data entry.

##### Automate workflows

Turn meeting notes into CRM records, generate follow-up tasks and automate repetitive sales workflows through natural conversation.

## Your best day, every day. With Skills.

MCP gives your AI assistant access to Pipedrive. Skills are ready-made instructions that show Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools how to handle everyday sales tasks, using your live Pipedrive data. Skills handle the busywork behind a good sales week: where to focus, what’s slipping and whether you’re on track. Every rep starts each day knowing what matters, not digging for it.

[Learn more](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/features/mcp-skills)

##### Where should I focus today?

##### What is slipping, and what's next?

##### Are we on track to hit that number?

## Your AI assistant gets access. You stay in control.

An official, reliable and fully supported connection built and maintained by Pipedrive.

##### Secure by design

Your AI assistant can only work with information Pipedrive users already have permission to see/edit.

##### Fast and easy setup

Connect in minutes through secure OAuth. No coding, no API development, no developer required.

##### Live CRM data

Your AI assistant works with real-time CRM data, not delayed syncs or outdated information.

## See what your AI assistant can do

##### Ask instead of click

*“Show me all open deals over $10K that haven’t been updated in two weeks.”*

Opens in new window

##### Build from meeting notes

*“Here are my notes from today’s call. Create a deal, contact and follow-up activity.”*

Opens in new window

##### Move deals through the pipeline

*“Move the Acme Corp deal to Proposal Sent and schedule a follow-up for Friday.”*

Opens in new window

##### Create new leads instantly

*"Create a new lead for TechCorp. Contact is Sarah Lee, Head of Sales."*

Opens in new window

##### Get instant pipeline insights

*“Which deals are most likely to close this month and what are the next steps?”*

Opens in new window

##### Find anything in seconds

*“Search deals, contacts and leads by name, email, or phone and pull up the full record.”*

Opens in new window

## Frequently asked questions

- ### What is the Pipedrive MCP server?
	Pipedrive MCP (Model Context Protocol) connects your AI assistant directly to Pipedrive, allowing it to securely access, update and act on your CRM data using natural language.
- ### What can I do with it?
	You can query CRM data, update records and automate workflows directly from your AI assistant. Find deals, update contacts, create activities, analyze pipelines and automate repetitive tasks using natural “plain” language.
- ### Who can use the Pipedrive MCP?
	All Pipedrive customers, on every plan. Usage is subject to token limits based on your plan and you can purchase additional tokens if needed.
- ### How do I get started with the Pipedrive MCP server?
	Connect your AI assistant to Pipedrive in minutes through secure OAuth, no coding or developer required. See the Pipedrive MCP documentation for step-by-step instructions.
- ### Which AI assistants are supported?
	Pipedrive MCP works with any AI assistant that supports custom MCP connections. We provide setup guides for ChatGPT and Claude and other assistants can connect using the Pipedrive MCP server URL.
- ### Does it adhere to my existing Pipedrive permissions?
	Yes. Your AI assistant can only access and modify data your Pipedrive user already has permission to view and edit. All actions are recorded in the change log for full auditability.
- ### Is my data safe?
	Yes. Pipedrive MCP is built and maintained by Pipedrive and follows our security standards. Your AI assistant can only access data within the scope of your permissions. Your AI provider's own privacy and security policies also apply.
- ### Is there an extra cost?
	Pipedrive MCP is available on all Pipedrive plans. Usage is based on token limits included in your plan and additional tokens can be purchased if needed.

###### Topics

## Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) from Pipedrive

Yssel Salas

Last updated: November 4, 2026

A model context protocol, or **MCP**, is an open standard that allows large language models (**LLMs**) and AI assistants to securely interact with structured data and external services.

MCPs provide a standardized way for AI assistants to securely access business data, tools and [APIs](https://support.pipedrive.com/article/what-is-api). This allows AI applications to retrieve information, update records and automate workflows across connected systems.

So, rather than building separate integrations for every AI tool, businesses can use MCP to make their data and functionality available to any MCP-compatible AI application through a single and consistent interface.

---

## How does MCP work?

MCP acts as a bridge between an AI application and a business tool such as Pipedrive.

When a user asks an AI assistant a question or requests an action, the AI can use MCP to retrieve information from connected systems, perform approved actions on behalf of a user, combine data from multiple sources to complete a task or automate workflows across business applications.

For example, an AI assistant connected to Pipedrive through MCP can:

- Find details about a deal, deal, contact or organization
- Create or update records
- Retrieve sales pipeline information
- Generate summaries of customer interactions
- Answer questions using data stored in Pipedrive

---

## Why use Pipedrive’s native MCP?

Pipedrive’s native MCP makes it easier for AI assistants to securely and reliably connect with Pipedrive and interact with your CRM data directly from AI assistants.

By using a standardized protocol, MCP reduces the need for custom integrations and allows compatible AI tools to access information and perform actions in Pipedrive more efficiently.

This helps businesses adopt AI-powered workflows faster while maintaining a consistent and reliable connection between their tools and CRM data.

### MCP access

MCP does **not** automatically grant access to your Pipedrive data.

Access is managed through authentication, permissions and authorization settings. AI applications can access information and perform actions only when explicitly permitted by the user or administrator.

This ensures that you remain in control of your Pipedrive data while benefiting from AI-powered capabilities.

---

## Key use cases

Once connected, your AI assistant can access data, perform actions and help automate workflows in Pipedrive, based on the permissions granted to your account.

| **Use case** | **Example prompt** |
| --- | --- |
| **Ask instead of click** | *Show me all open deals that haven’t been updated in two weeks* |
| **Let AI update your CRM** | *Create a follow-up call for next Monday and add today’s meeting notes to the deal* |
| **Get instant pipeline insights** | *Which deals are most likely to close this month, and what are the next steps?* |
| **Build from meeting notes** | *Here are my notes from today’s call. Create a deal, contact, and follow-up activity* |
| **Cross-tool automation** | *Summarize all overdue deals and draft follow-up emails for each one* |
| **Move deals through the pipeline** | **Move the \[company name\] deal to the \[specific stage name\] stage and schedule a follow-up for \[date\]** |
| **Add contacts from a photo** | *Attach a photo of a business card and tell the assistant to add the person as a contact and link them to a specific deal* |
| **Find anything in seconds** | *Search deals, contacts, organizations, and leads by name, email, phone, and pull up complete records, history, and pipeline position on demand* |

---

## Set up guide

The setup process depends on the AI assistant your company uses.

Refer to the appropriate guide below for step-by-step instructions on connecting Pipedrive through MCP.

If you need the list of MCP tools, you can find it in the following entry:

- **[Pipedrive MCP tools](https://support.pipedrive.com/article/mcp-tools)**
